properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 6:21AM CDT until August 10 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 621 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated the strongest storms and
heaviest rain rates have ended. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen with the storms this morning. Additional rainfall amounts up
to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area as rain slowly ends.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Gardner, Spring Hill, Clare,
Stanley and Stilwell.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 7:20AM EDT until August 10 at 8:45AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SMWCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open waters from The Islands OH to Avon Point OH...

* Until 845 AM EDT.

* At 720 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 8 nm north of Put-In-Bay to 8 nm southwest of
Sandusky Bay, moving east at 45 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Western Vermilion, Huron, Avon Point, Sandusky Bay, Lorain Harbor,
and Vermilion.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
